isolation.owner_goal: Add five user-uploaded Jyotish reference books to the astrology research and read them independently of the other active astrology reader; preserve scientific blinding and parallel-work isolation.

archival_policy.reason: Modern editions/translations carry copyright or unclear redistribution rights. GitHub research branch stores fingerprints, source locations, short analytical paraphrases and bounded quotations, not full books.
archival_policy.source_availability: Uploaded into the initiating conversation; raw files must be reattached in a fresh session unless held separately by the owner.
archival_policy.research_status: Source annotations are NOT observed successes, independent confirmations, frozen production rules, or prospective human validation.

sources.title: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra
sources.edition: Portuguese adaptation translated by André Kerr from an English translation, with Santhanam-attributed additions; not Sanskrit critical edition
risk_notes: Reading as UTF-8 corrupts accent characters

D-30 enumerates five segments but only four planetary rulers in the Portuguese text; suspected omission, do not repair without source collation
Do not adopt introductory historical dating claim without independent specialist verification
